We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Designer to own the surfaces where Runway turns usage into revenue: pricing, upgrade paths, checkout, and the moments a creator decides Runway is worth paying more for. You'll partner with growth engineering, product, and data to turn goals like ARR growth, expansion revenue, and reduced churn into tested, shipped design changes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own growth-critical surfaces (pricing pages, paywalls, upgrade prompts, and checkout flows) from concept through shipped, tested experiments

- Turn business goals like ARR growth, expansion revenue, and reduced churn into design hypotheses and interface changes you can test

- Design and read A/B tests and other experiments with growth engineering and data, iterating fast on what moves the numbers

- Collaborate closely with growth engineering and product to ship experiments quickly and turn winners into permanent product surfaces

- Contribute to visual and interaction consistency between growth surfaces and the rest of the product

- Set the design direction for Runway's growth surfaces and mentor other designers working in the funnel

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- Experience designing product surfaces tied directly to revenue and can point to what moved ARR, conversion, or expansion revenue in a past role

- Comfort running and reading quantitative experiments, not just shipping a single "best" design

- Experience designing flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI's for web products, with strong visual design skills

- Experience delivering and iterating fast in close collaboration with engineering, and product teams

- Ability and flexibility to iterate fast and often

- Comfortable picking up unfamiliar parts of the product rather than waiting to be assigned only what you already know

- Knowledge and understanding of the creative tool space

- Bonus points if you have experience creating functional prototypes using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)

- At Runway, it's always a bonus if you have artistic and creative potential (particularly skills with video/audio editing, icon/typography design, illustration, etc.)

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.

Responsibilities:

•

Partner with account executives across Australia to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation

•

Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers across Australia throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success

•

Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work

•

Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences across Australia. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives

•

Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers across Australia integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack

•

Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases

•

Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams

•

Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building

•

Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns

You may be a good fit if you have:

•

10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

•

Experience working with enterprise customers, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders

•

Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more

•

Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders

•

Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems

•

Comfortable with python

•

Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science

•

Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

•

A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed

•

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

•

Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

About the Team

Workday’s Corporate Treasury team combines strategic thinking with analytical rigor to support the company’s growth and financial strength. We deliver the liquidity insights, discipline, and cross-functional partnership needed to help the business scale with confidence.

About the Role

Workday is seeking a Senior Treasury Manager to join our Corporate Treasury team. This is a highly visible role for a treasury professional who brings strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work across functions to strengthen forecast accuracy and liquidity planning. You will play a key role in translating forecast signals into actionable guidance for treasury leadership and business partners. You will also help identify opportunities to use AI and emerging tools to improve forecasting processes, strengthen insight generation, and enhance forecast accuracy.

• Lead the global rolling 13-week cash flow forecast, with end-to-end ownership for forecast quality, rigor, and continuous improvement.

Job Description – Sr. Director, TestOps

Coupang operates a large distributed technology ecosystem where changes must be validated quickly, safely, and repeatedly across infrastructure and application boundaries. We are seeking a Director, TestOps to build and lead testing as a platform capability. This leader will own test automation, test environments and data, integration testing, resilience validation, quality signals, and AI-assisted testing. The mission is to move testing from a manual phase owned independently by teams into an automated, federated, and measurable platform that enables safe continuous delivery. We are looking for a visionary quality-platform leader who has previously built and scaled comparable TestOps, test infrastructure, or continuous-quality systems in a leading global technology company.

Key Responsibilities

• Set a bold vision for testing as a company-wide platform capability and translate that vision into an executable roadmap adopted across infrastructure and domain organizations.
• Define and execute the TestOps strategy across Tech Infrastructure and partner engineering organizations.
• Build a federated testing platform that supports infrastructure, platform, API, UI, integration, resilience, and release validation.
• Create repeatable test capabilities for Unified Staging and production-like environments.
• Partner with Developer Platform, SRE, Observability, Security, and domain teams to embed quality gates into delivery workflows.
• Own testing metrics including coverage, pass rate, escaped defects, flaky tests, execution time, environment readiness, and release confidence.
• Drive adoption through product management, customer enablement, documentation, office hours, and clear service-level objectives.

Test Platform & Automation

• Build self-service test planning, execution, orchestration, reporting, and evidence-management capabilities.
• Automate UI, API, service integration, infrastructure integration, and end-to-end test execution.
• Provide reusable test harnesses, reference applications, simulators, mocks, and service-virtualization capabilities.
• Integrate TestOps with CI/CD, Global CD, Application Registry, observability, and release governance.
• Create quality gates that are risk-aware, fast, deterministic, and appropriate to service tiers.
• Reduce flaky tests, duplicated frameworks, manual validation, and fragmented tooling.

Unified Staging, Test Data & Resilience Validation

• Use Unified Staging as the default environment for validating Tech Infrastructure components and domain applications.
• Build compliant, desensitized, production-like test data generation and lifecycle management.
• Enable integration testing across identity, mesh, networking, databases, queues, storage, observability, and application dependencies.
• Partner with SRE to automate fault injection, DR scenarios, failover validation, load testing, and reliability certification.
• Ensure validation evidence can feed release decisions, RBD/RBO certification, and executive reliability metrics.

AI-Assisted Testing

• Build AI-assisted capabilities for feature test-plan generation, test-case generation, test-data generation, execution, failure analysis, and defect triage.
• Establish evaluation, safety, and quality mechanisms for AI-generated tests and recommendations.
• Use production telemetry and incident learnings to continuously improve test coverage and prioritize high-risk scenarios.
• Automate quality insights and next-best-action recommendations for engineers and release owners.

Talent Leadership & Organization

• Lead managers, technical leads, and senior engineers across test platform, automation, and quality engineering.
• Own organization design, hiring, leadership development, and succession planning.
• Build a strong engineering culture focused on platform products rather than manual test execution.
• Develop leaders who can independently own federation, test infrastructure, AI TestOps, and resilience validation.
• Attract engineers with deep test infrastructure, distributed systems, developer tooling, and automation expertise.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

• Own architecture for test orchestration, environment integration, test data, result storage, quality signals, and release gating.
• Define company standards for test APIs, frameworks, evidence, coverage, flakiness, and service-tier validation.
• Influence platform architecture to improve testability, observability, fault isolation, and safe deployment.
• Align test strategy with the broader observability and AIOps architecture so pre-release and post-release quality signals reinforce one another.

Execution & Impact

• Deliver measurable reductions in manual testing, execution time, escaped defects, flaky tests, and release-related incidents.
• Increase automated integration and resilience validation across Tier 0, Tier 1, and Tech Infrastructure services.
• Improve release confidence and developer productivity through reliable self-service testing.
• Establish strong execution mechanisms, customer feedback loops, and objective quarterly targets.

Essential Qualifications

• Leadership experience in a best-in-class test infrastructure, developer productivity, continuous delivery, or reliability engineering organization at hyperscaler, global consumer platform, or similarly scaled technology company.
• Experience with Kubernetes, cloud-native testing, service mesh, fault injection, or chaos engineering.
• Experience building AI-assisted test generation or failure-analysis systems.
• Experience with load testing, DR validation, release certification, or production-readiness programs.
• 12+ years of experience in software engineering, test infrastructure, developer productivity, quality engineering, or platform engineering.
• 5+ years leading engineering teams and managers in a large-scale technology environment.
• Recognized as a strong technology and organizational leader with the ability to define a differentiated quality engineering vision, attract exceptional talent, and influence senior stakeholders.
• Demonstrated experience personally leading the architecture, build-out, launch, and scaled adoption of a TestOps, test infrastructure, continuous-quality, or release-validation platform.
• Experience building test automation or testing platforms for distributed systems and continuous delivery.
• Deep understanding of CI/CD, test environments, test data, integration testing, reliability testing, and quality metrics.
• Experience driving cross-organizational adoption of common platforms and standards.
• Strong technical judgment, customer focus, and ability to translate strategy into measurable delivery.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Marketing Analytics Lead at Anthropic, you will own how we measure marketing. You'll build and run a single measurement framework that shows how marketing activity turns into pipeline, revenue, and product usage, and you'll make that framework something marketers and executives actually use to make decisions. As our marketing programs grow across enterprise and product-led motions, your work will determine whether we invest in what works.

In this role, you'll own the marketing measurement framework end to end: the metric definitions, the data models behind them, the dashboards that surface them, and the insights they produce. This is a hands-on individual contributor role; data science and data engineering will support you, but you'll do the core work yourself. You'll partner closely with field marketing, partner marketing, campaign marketing, finance, sales strategy, sales development, data science, and data engineering to align on definitions and keep the whole organization working from one view of the funnel.

Key responsibilities

• Own the marketing measurement framework that connects marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and product usage
• Set the direction for the framework and extend it to programs it doesn't cover yet
• Define marketing metrics clearly and get cross-functional teams to agree on definitions early
• Build and maintain the data models that power marketing reporting
• Develop dashboards that marketers and executives rely on in their weekly reviews
• Teach marketers and executives how the metrics work, and keep teaching as the metrics evolve
• Lead adoption of the framework so that both marketing and executive teams use it as their shared source of truth
• Partner with finance, sales strategy, and sales development to connect marketing measurement to the broader revenue picture
• Find and share the insights nobody asked for, turning analysis into recommendations that change what we do
• Write analytical SQL on large datasets to answer questions about funnel performance and attribution
• Track framework gaps and data quality issues, and work with data engineering to resolve them
• Present findings to marketing leadership and executives in clear, decision-ready formats

Minimum qualifications

• Have deep experience with marketing analytics, including lead funnels, attribution to enterprise pipeline, and product usage measurement
• Have designed metrics from scratch and know what makes a metric trusted and useful
• Can write analytical SQL on large datasets with confidence
• Have built data models in tools like dbt and dashboards that many people use daily
• Are comfortable setting direction without waiting for a plan to be handed to you
• Can turn vague questions into clear, measurable definitions
• Work well across functions and know how to get teams aligned on definitions before problems surface
• Enjoy teaching others how metrics work and helping non-technical audiences build data fluency
• Finish what you start, from first definition to adopted dashboard
• Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building marketing measurement for both enterprise sales-led and product-led growth motions
• Familiarity with marketing attribution models and their practical tradeoffs
• Experience presenting metrics and insights directly to executives and shaping how leadership reviews performance
• A background in data science, analytics engineering, or marketing operations
• Experience working with CRM and marketing automation data, such as Salesforce and related tooling
• Experience standing up a measurement practice where one didn't exist before
• Familiarity with how finance and sales strategy teams think about pipeline and forecasting

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$255,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
